subject.title: [BUG]: Browser tool: `snapshot` returns page content before scroll, ignoring viewport position

question: Should browser snapshot gain an additive visible-viewport mode, change its default text semantics to the visible viewport, or keep full-tree snapshots and document screenshots/labels as the viewport path?
rationale: Source inspection shows the gap, but the fix changes model-facing browser semantics and compatibility with workflows that depend on full-page accessibility trees and refs.

options.title: Add viewport-aware mode
options.body: Add an explicit visible-viewport snapshot/read mode or metadata field while keeping full AI/ARIA/role snapshots available for existing workflows.

options.title: Change snapshot default
options.body: Make default snapshot text follow the visible viewport and accept the compatibility risk for existing full-tree snapshot workflows.

options.title: Document current contract
options.body: Keep snapshot as a structured page-tree read and direct visible-position workflows to screenshots with labels and annotations.

recommendation.title: Add viewport-aware mode
recommendation.body: Add an explicit visible-viewport snapshot/read mode or metadata field while keeping full AI/ARIA/role snapshots available for existing workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the browser plugin's public model-facing contract, and current history points to steipete as the strongest product-boundary owner.
